name: Paradise, CA
story: What if Paradise had cut fuel breaks before November 8, 2018?
crawl: A transmission line fails above the Feather River canyon.
Winds are 50 miles per hour, out of the northeast.
Paradise is 17 kilometers downwind. 26,000 people. 11,000 homes.
No fuel breaks stand between the fire and the town.
homes_note: Homes are estimated from developed-land cells at 2018 density, not individual footprints.
